title: Make Texas-Size Profits in TXN
text: Texas Instruments Inc. (TXN) -- This manufacturer of semiconductors, and handheld graphics and scientific calculators has been in a bull market since it bottomed in February 2009 at under $15. Standard & Poor's rates TXN a "four-star buy" with a 12-month target of $32. It executed a gold cross in May 2009, and since July it has been consolidating within the handle of a bullish cup-and-handle chart pattern .
